daily.career: Your creative energy is flowing, and collaboration feels less draining than usual. This is a solid day to pitch ideas or reach out to someone you've been meaning to connect with. Trust your instincts on timing.
daily.health: Your body's asking for balance—not just physically but mentally. A short walk, some water, or even five minutes of doing absolutely nothing can reset your whole system. Listen to what feels grounding right now.
